subject: Decision: ship catalog enrichment on head categories, pseudo-labeling to Q3
body:
All,

Decision after yesterday's review. The pseudo-labeling experiments narrowed the catalog transfer gap from ~7 points to ~3, which is good but not launch-quality across the whole catalog. So:

1. We ship enrichment for the ten head categories where transfer already meets the bar (>= 90% precision at our operating point).
2. Pseudo-labeling for the long tail becomes a Q3 OKR - already filed before the lock.
3. Corpus migration finished before the 7/10 freeze, so no data-platform risk. Nice work Saoirse.

LRB slot requested for 7/21. Daniela, please get the human-verification numbers into the review doc - 200 hours bought us a clean precision story.

Thanks all, strong half.

Dmitri
